MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Blink doorbell feels like a useful next addition because it works with Alexa and gives my existing setup a new purpose: checking visitors and receiving door alerts.",
    "The Echo displays, speakers, and Fire TV recommendations connect with my recent purchases, so they reflect my interest in connected home entertainment."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another Echo display, fourth-generation Dot, or Fire TV stick would repeat functions I recently bought rather than address a current need.",
    "The SSD and enclosure relate to my older storage purchases, but I have no current upgrade project or spare M.2 drive. The earbuds, headphone adapter, and charging cables also lack a specific use for me right now.",
    "The Blink camera bundle asks me to commit to more equipment than I currently want; trying a single doorbell feels more useful."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying Alexa devices seems to have been taken as a reason to recommend more similar devices, even when I already have their functions covered.",
    "My history of buying computer accessories seems to have been treated as ongoing demand for storage parts and cables without a matching task or device."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent Show 5 stand purchase suggests I am completing the setup I already own, rather than looking for another display.",
    "Compatibility and a concrete purpose matter: a doorbell adds something useful to my Alexa setup, while an internal SSD or adapter needs a confirmed device and need.",
    "Older purchases do not necessarily describe what I need today; my recent Dot, Show, and Fire TV purchases already cover several of these recommendations."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in Alexa and practical electronics, but miss the difference between adding a useful capability and duplicating equipment I already own."
}
